filesToTouch.what: The ENTIRE current src/server/app/routes.js body (lines 1-77, verified live this session) moved verbatim — all 41 import lines and the `export const liveAnimals = { plugin: { name: 'live-animals', register: async (server) => { ...13 wiring calls... } } }` block, byte-identical. Still exports `liveAnimals`. No behavioural change and no import-path edits needed: the file sits in the same directory (src/server/app/) as routes.js, so every relative './...' specifier resolves identically. Do not add migration comments (git history is the record).

Two lines (verified live: lines 7 and 20). Line 7: `import { liveAnimals } from './app/routes.js'` becomes `import { servedSet } from './app/routes.js'`. Line 20: `const routes = [liveAnimals]` becomes `const routes = [servedSet()]`. servedSet() is called inside register(), so SERVED_SET is read at boot, and an unknown value throws during server.register — the required loud boot failure. The `authEnabled`/signout push and everything else in router.js is untouched.

routes-is-the-gateway rule (line 31): pathNot array `[`^${APP}/sets/`, `^${APP}/routes\\.js$`, '\\.test\\.js$']` gains `` `^${APP}/routes-live-animals\\.js$` `` — required NOW because the moved file imports sets/live-animals/** and npm run lint (which runs lint:arch) is in this increment's ladder. Do NOT add routes-plant-products.js or touch the sets-not-l1 rule here (pp-010's P-4 owns those, alongside the file pp-007 creates). Do NOT regenerate .dependency-cruiser-known-violations.json (baseline discipline, P-4).

Keep the existing 'promoted live-animals route authentication' describe untouched (it imports allRoutes from the set directly, unaffected by the split). Add a new describe('served-set selector') with: import { servedSet, servedSetName } from './routes.js' and import { liveAnimals } from './routes-live-animals.js'. Cases (use vi.stubEnv + vi.unstubAllEnvs in afterEach): (1) SERVED_SET unset → servedSetName() === 'live-animals' and servedSet() is the liveAnimals plugin object (identity, toBe); (2) SERVED_SET='live-animals' → servedSet() toBe liveAnimals; (3) SERVED_SET='garbage' → servedSet() throws an Error whose message names the bad value (/Unknown SERVED_SET "garbage"/). Behaviour-on-input/output only — no toHaveBeenCalled.

notes: Pure behaviour-preserving refactor of live-animals L1 wiring, verifiable on its own against the existing suite before any plant code exists (rationale from MAPPING.json). Consumes SIBLING-SET-PLAN §4.1 items 1, 3, 4; FD-1 (SERVED_SET, set-neutral name, default live-animals); FD-2 (routes.js becomes selector; static imports of gateways safe because configure* runs only inside the selected plugin's register — verified: all 13 wiring calls sit inside register at routes.js:47-73). FD-4: shared/paths.js untouched. Planner decisions (headless): (1) the SETS map ships live-animals-only — the brief offered selector-with-live-animals-only vs placeholder; importing a not-yet-existing routes-plant-products.js is impossible and a stub placeholder would be dead code, so pp-007 adds the plant import + map entry + its selector test case. (2) The dep-cruiser routes-is-the-gateway pathNot edit CANNOT wait for pp-010: routes-live-animals.js imports sets/** and this increment's own ladder runs lint:arch — pp-010's P-4 scope narrows to the routes-plant-products.js entry + the sets-not-l1 forbidden-target additions. (3) Selector tests live in the existing routes.test.js (the file that names routes.js) rather than a new file; the existing describe is untouched because it imports the set's allRoutes directly, not routes.js — verified live this session, so the liveAnimals export move breaks no test. (4) SERVED_SET=garbage acceptance is proven by unit test, not a manual boot (no-manual-verification rule). No new Playwright specs: zero UI/behaviour change; the existing features + journeys suites are the regression net and both run in the ladder (journey specs on a fresh stack can be flaky in beforeEach with transient 500s — recover-on-retry green is a pass). Two-sided sibling check degenerates to one side here: the plant set does not exist yet (dependsOn []), so sibling safety = the full existing live-animals ladder + default-boot-unchanged, which IS this ladder; pp-007/pp-010 pick up the plant side. Exemplar files pinned this session: src/server/app/routes.js:1-77, src/server/router.js:7,20, .dependency-cruiser.cjs:25-34, src/server/app/routes.test.js:1-13.
